question: Dividing Rs. 742 into two parts in the ratio of 5 : 9 will give the two parts as:
solution:
Given:

Rs. 742 is being divided into two parts in the ratio of 5 : 9

Concept used:

Ratio and Proportion

Calculation:

First part = 742 × {5 over (5 + 9)} = Rs. 265

First part = 742 × {9 over (5 + 9)} = Rs. 477

**∴ Dividing Rs. 742 into two parts in the ratio of 5 : 9 will give the two parts as Rs. 265, Rs. 477.**
